The sentence stating how the 4 m3 of natural gas was converted into final energy is cut off by the page break, so the MJ value rests on a standard heating value.

inputs.name: Grain maize IP, at farm
inputs.note: Tab. 12.2: grain maize IP is 10 % import and 90 % CH production, and of the CH production 100 % is IP; the 'values used in ecoinvent data' column is IP 100 / extensive 0 / organic 0. Imports are explicitly approximated by Swiss IP production ('Production abroad is therefore approximated by integrated production ... with location in Switzerland'), so the whole kilogram is drawn from the IP-at-farm module. The table gives shares, not an amount, so 1 kg per kg is the implied value with no processing loss stated.
